name: Yearly County-Level Outcome Counts
description: Yearly County-level counts of mental health qualifying Medicaid MAX-TAF inpatient admissions (n_adm__<cohort>) for the `icdset1_dxall_all` definition. Cohorts: total, ffs (fee-for-service all year), dual (dual-eligible all year), disabled (disability-based eligibility all year), full_benefit (full Medicaid benefits all year).
